title: Document access
rule: A document read must reject an actor whose tenantId differs from the document's tenantId before returning that document. A read by an actor in the same tenant is permitted. Use the actor and document supplied to the changed operation; an upstream check must not be assumed when none is shown.

expected.issue: Cross-tenant callers receive the document because the changed read removes its tenant check.

title: Response contract
rule: The changed readCount operation must return the response shape and value types declared in api-contract.json. The published response field count is required and must be an integer. Compare the actual handler return value with that contract; a renamed implementation variable is allowed when it preserves the response contract.

expected.issue: The changed handler serializes count as a string despite the unchanged integer response contract.

title: Save completion
rule: The save operation may report saved only after its supplied write promise succeeds, and must propagate a write rejection to its caller. Awaiting the promise or returning a promise chain are both permitted. Do not require the async/await syntax when another implementation has the same completion and rejection behavior.

expected.issue: The changed operation reports saved before persistence succeeds and swallows write rejection.
